description: Returns available unit of measure options for use in environmental incident record forms. Each option contains a label for display and a value to submit when creating or updating environmental records.

label.description: Human-readable display name for the unit of measure (e.g. 'lump sum'). Use in UI dropdowns and form labels.

value.description: Server-side value to submit when creating or updating an environmental record's unit of measure (e.g. 'ls').
